description: Deleting the tree's org-kind node with NO If-Match is refused 428 Precondition Required / IF_MATCH_REQUIRED, not 409. API-022 is categorical — a state-changing request against an existing mutable resource that omits If-Match MUST be rejected 428 — and api/1 carves out nothing, so the org node gets the same precondition treatment as every other node. DAT-022's own refusal still applies; it is simply reached after the precondition rather than before it, which DAT-022 permits because it requires only that the refusal HAPPEN. This case exists because the opposite order shipped and was pinned by a unit test and an openapi description, neither of which is normative: the order is now frozen where a conformance driver reads it. The request carries a Trace-Id and no If-Match: the trace id is echoed into the Problem (API-060/061) while the ABSENT If-Match is what the case is about, so a reader cannot mistake the header block for the precondition it deliberately omits.
